*F-vote* (Self-tallying election) is part of *Layer 8: Time and Application Composites* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Recently acquired a UC anchor via a 2025 paper on universally composable self-tallying elections over anonymous broadcast.

*References:*

- Ackermann et al. *E-cclesia: Universally composable self-tallying elections over anonymous broadcast*. IACR Communications in Cryptology, 2(3), 2025.
